prompt:
Photograph of a real 17th-century Spanish war galleon under sail, seen
from above at an angle: a large weathered dark oak hull whose deck
rises in steps to a raised sterncastle two decks high, its stern a
carved and gilded transom with open stern galleries, part of the hull
and of the same wood; painted bands along its side, two rows of gun
ports, tarred rigging,
patched cream canvas sails all set and full. It floats on the water,
its hull cut at the waterline. Plain flat blue background. Historical
reenactment photography, sharp focus, realistic.
